detail.longDescription: At some point I'm going to have to find some time to do a migration from the old Mastodon helm chart to the new one. But it will mean standing up my own Postgres and Elastic Search as they have removed them from the new version. Basically sounds like a backup and reinstall job. https:// github.com/mastodon/helm-chart s/blob/main/charts/mastodon/MIGRATION.md # mastoadmin # kubernetes # mastodon
